case_number: 2025 INSC 67; CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) NO(S). OF 2025 [@ DIARY NO(S). 1408 OF 2021] IN CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 1188 OF 2018 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Contempt petitions alleging non-compliance; petitions filed by employees not party to original Civil Appeal No. 2703 of 2017; orders not in personam; salary/pension arrears disputed; fact-finding enquiry ordered by Registrar/Vice Chancellor; pension withheld erroneously per Baidya Nath Choudhary contempt orders; directions for claims submission, discrete enquiries, reasoned orders within three months.
final_judgment: Contempt petitions disposed of; claims to be adjudicated by Registrar/Vice Chancellor within three months; pension reinstated w.e.f. absorption date; recovery mechanism for excess payments allowed; right to appeal to High Court preserved.
